description: This file contains unit tests for the NodePairingReconcilePolicy component within the OpenClaw project. It defines test cases to verify the behavior of polling policies and safety intervals.

methods.name: policy polls only when active
methods.description: Tests that the polling only occurs when the node is active or pending, based on the policy's conditions.

methods.name: policy uses slow safety interval
methods.description: Tests that the safety interval used by the policy is at least 10 seconds (10000 milliseconds).
